registerEnroll.q: How do I register and enrol my child in a class?
registerEnroll.note: Each enrolment is linked to a specific child profile, so make sure you select the right one before checkout.

viewPerformance.q: How can I view my child's performance or progress?
viewPerformance.a1: These insights help you understand not just what your child learns, but how they learn best.
viewPerformance.extraTitle: Insights are divided into three parts:
extraBullets: Overall Analysis: see how your child performs across enrolled programs.
Class Performance: view feedback from each centre for completed lessons.
Character Analysis: After attending 10 or more classes, your child will receive a personalized character profile reflecting their learning style and strengths.

subscription.q: Do I need a subscription to use ClassZ?
subscription.a1: A subscription is optional but offers extra benefits:
bullets: Enroll without platform fees
Better pricing on selected classes and events
Access to exclusive programs or events
Priority customer support
subscription.note: You can still book classes and pay with credit cards without subscribing.

zing.q: What is Zing and how does it work?
zing.a1: Zing is the credit used in ClassZ to pay for programs and events.
bullets: It never expires
Works for both subscribers and non-subscribers
Can be used even after unsubscribing
zing.note: It's a flexible way to pay and save within the ClassZ ecosystem.

refund.q: What happens if a class is cancelled or I need a refund? What if I couldn't attend a rearranged class?
refund.a1: We offer "Protected Booking" for parents. You are eligible for Zing refunds if:
refund.a2: However, to maintain fairness and quality:
bullets: The centre cancels the class
Service provided is different from what was described
Centre fails to provide performance feedback within 10 days (discount compensation applies)
Fraud or misconduct occurs
Rearranged classes that you were unable to attend
bulletsSecondary: No refund, replacement class, or feedback will be provided if your child is absent without valid reason
All refunds are issued in Zing at the best-value exchange rate
To request a refund, please [create a support ticket] anytime before the class starts and up to 48 hours after the rearranged class ends.
Requests made beyond this period will be considered unattended and not eligible for refund.

badWeather.q: What happens during bad weather (typhoons, heavy rain)?

weatherRows.arrangement: Centre may choose to continue, cancel, or reschedule

weatherRows.signal: Black Rain / Signal No.8 or above / Extreme Weather Warning
weatherRows.arrangement: Classes must be cancelled or rescheduled

weatherNotes: Cancelled classes are refunded via Zing.
If the rearranged time doesn't work for you, please [create a support ticket] anytime before the class starts and up to 48 hours after the rearranged class ends to arrange a refund.
Requests made after this period will be considered unattended and not eligible for refund.

sen.q: Do centres support SEN (Special Educational Needs) students?
sen.a1: Centres with an SEN tag on their profile welcome students with special educational needs.
sen.a2: You can also check individual program details for SEN-friendly options.
sen.a3: During enrolment, you may provide your child's background or SEN requirements for the centre's reference.
bullets: SEN support is not guaranteed and varies depending on each centre's capability.

multipleChildren.q: Can I enroll multiple children under one account?
bullets: Zing credits are shared across all children.
All enrolments are final and non-refundable once payment is made.

classPhotos.q: Where can I see my child's class photos?
bullets: Photo uploads depend on each centre.
Centres are encouraged to upload photos or work outcomes when appropriate and when allowed by venue rules (e.g. no photography in swimming pools).

contactHelp.q: How can I contact a centre or get help?
contactHelp.a1: If you experience any issues or wish to report a centre, please contact ClassZ support by [create a support ticket] or email.
contactHelp.a2: Our team will respond as soon as possible.

pricing.a1: Contact us via [How to Join Us] to confirm eligibility in your region.
bullets: Free to list and use our CRM for eligible centres.
0% commission on bookings for eligible partners.
ClassZ covers standard third-party payment processor fees—centres don't pay these.

payment.q: How do parents pay for classes? Are offline payments allowed?
payment.a1: All bookings and payments happen within ClassZ using integrated third-party payment methods (e.g., credit/debit cards).
payment.a2: Offline payments are not allowed and are not protected by ClassZ. Bypassing the platform may lead to account actions up to permanent removal.
bullets: This gives parents more ways to pay without centres paying any additional or third-party processing charges—ClassZ covers the standard processor fees for eligible centres.

mandatoryFeedback.q: Are lesson photos and performance feedback mandatory after every class? What if we don't submit?
mandatoryFeedback.a2: Submit one class photo and provide feedback via our built-in Student Performance Feedback system.
mandatoryFeedback.a3: Repeated or serious misses may lead to fees, suspension, or permanent removal.
bullets: It's simplified and typically takes under a minute to complete while ensuring clear, consistent insights for parents with our system.

editSchedule.q: Can I edit or update class schedules after posting?
editSchedule.a1: Yes—by request only. Edits require approval and follow strict fairness rules.

howItWorks.title: How it works:
bullets: Open the corresponding class schedule in the app and submit an class schedule edit request (rearrangement).
We'll review your request. Approval is rare and usually limited to emergencies or safety concerns.
If approved, the system automatically moves all enrolled students to the updated timeslot and notifies families.

bullets.text: If a class is rearranged (approved edit), any student who can't attend the new time may no-show without penalty.
bullets.subBullet: → They receive a full refund for that session, and the centre will not receive payment for that student's session.

bullets.text: If an edit isn't approved, you must run the class as originally scheduled.
bullets.subBullet: → If the class is not provided as scheduled, the session is treated as centre responsibility; all students receive a full refund for that session, and the incident is recorded and may lead to consequences.

noEnrollment.title: Does not have enrollment yet? Create a new slot with the correct details. If the original slot has no enrollments, you may cancel it and re-release.
bullets: Accuracy first: Please publish only final, confirmed details.
No direct renegotiation: Messaging parents to change slot details is not allowed and may result in penalties if reported.

editSchedule.note: For severe weather situations, follow the Bad-Weather Arrangement policy—the system handles those cases separately.

registerCentre.q: How do I register my centre and get listed on ClassZ?
registerCentre.a1: Start on [How to Join Us] and submit the short form.
bullets: We verify your details and program quality.
Once approved, create branches, publish programs, and accept enrollments on ClassZ.

accountTypes.q: What's the difference between Owner, Manager, and Coach accounts?
accountTypes.a1: Owner: full control—branches, programs, payouts, roles, compliance.
accountTypes.a2: Manager: promoted from Coach by the Owner, can publish programs, manage schedules, and message.
accountTypes.a3: Coach: runs classes—takes attendance, uploads lesson photos, submits feedback.
accountTypes.a4: In each branch, you can have unlimited Coaches and Managers; but only one Owner.

multipleBranches.q: Can one Owner manage multiple branches or locations?
multipleBranches.a1: Yes—an Owner can manage unlimited branches.
multipleBranches.a2: Each branch is reviewed before it appears to parents.
multipleBranches.a3: You can set a different venue per program schedule (e.g., pool, museum, sports ground) than your branch address—this keeps coaching locations flexible and accurate for parents.

profileInfo.q: What information is required to set up my centre profile?
profileInfo.a1: Basics: name, description, categories, SEN readiness, contact info, logo/photos.
profileInfo.a2: Verification: Owner HKID (e.g., HKID for >25% ownership or equivalent), business/company details, and where permitted, background checks for child-facing roles.
profileInfo.a3: Not sure what applies? Submit [How to Join Us]—we'll review and advise for free.

badWeatherCentres.q: What is the bad-weather arrangement for centres?
badWeatherCentres.a1: During official bad-weather signals, your dashboard unlocks the action buttons so you can choose Continue / Cancel / Reschedule for affected sessions.

weatherRows.arrangement: You may choose to continue, cancel, or reschedule

weatherRows.signal: Black Rain / Signal No.8 or above / Extreme Weather Warning
weatherRows.arrangement: Cancel or reschedule (classes must not proceed)

classzBullets: Select Continue / Cancel / Reschedule in your dashboard; parents are notified automatically.
Cancelled classes: parents receive a full refund.
Rescheduled classes: If a parent cannot attend the new time, they can opt for a full refund for that session.

goodFit.q: Is my centre a good fit for ClassZ?
bullets: Best fit: Small to medium-sized centres focused on quality, inclusivity (SEN-friendly), and transparent growth feedback, providing child-oriented program aged under 14.
Benefits: free CRM, multi-branch management, direct enrolment, messaging, and parent trust through lesson photos + feedback.
goodFit.a1: See [ClassZ Partnership] for specific benefits and examples. If it resonates, apply via [How to Join Us] and we'll guide you through next steps.

payouts.q: How do I make sure my payouts are released without penalties?

checklistBullets.text: Publish final, accurate details (date, time, venue, price, capacity, and assigned coach).
checklistBullets.rest: (date, time, venue, price, capacity, and assigned coach).

checklistBullets.text: Don't edit schedules after publishing. If changes are needed, create a new slot.
checklistBullets.rest: after publishing. If changes are needed, create a new slot.

checklistBullets.text: No offline payments. All bookings and payments must go through ClassZ.
checklistBullets.rest: All bookings and payments must go through ClassZ.

checklistBullets.text: Submit attendance, one class photo, and performance feedback via the built-in system after each class (same day recommended).
checklistBullets.highlight: Submit attendance, one class photo, and performance feedback via the built-in system

checklistBullets.text: Follow platform policies (e.g., don't message parents to renegotiate slot details).
checklistBullets.rest: (e.g., don't message parents to renegotiate slot details).

payouts.note: Violations (missing feedback/photos, offline payments, schedule manipulation, or other T&C breaches) can lead to payout holds, fees, suspension, or removal.

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content:
This Privacy Policy explains how ClassZ ("ClassZ", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects personal data when you access or use the ClassZ platform, including our website, mobile application, subscription services, credit system ("Zing"), booking features, feedback tools, and related services (collectively, the "Platform").

This Privacy Policy applies to parents, guardians, centres, coaches, and other users of the Platform and should be read together with our Terms & Conditions.

section2.title: 2. Compliance with Law
section2.content:
ClassZ complies with the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486 of the Laws of Hong Kong) ("PDPO").

We collect and process personal data in accordance with the data protection principles under the PDPO, including lawful purpose, data minimisation, transparency, security, and retention limitation.

section3.title: 3. Types of Personal Data We Collect

subsection1.title: 3.1 Parent Account Data
subsection1.content:
We may collect:

• Name
• Email address
• Phone number
• Location (district or region level)
• Account identifiers
• Payment and subscription status (no full card numbers stored)

subsection2.title: 3.2 Child Profile Data
subsection2.content:
Child data is provided solely by parents or legal guardians. We may collect:

• Child's name
• Hong Kong Identity Card number (or equivalent identifier)
• Date of birth
• School name
• SEN indication (if voluntarily provided)
• Emergency contact number
• Class enrolment records
• Attendance records
• Class-related feedback and insights
• Photos or media uploaded by centres in relation to attended classes

ClassZ does not independently verify child data and relies on information provided by parents and centres.

subsection3.title: 3.3 Centre Owner and Coach Data
subsection3.content:
We may collect:

• Name
• Email address
• Phone number
• Hong Kong Identity Card number
• Professional background, qualifications, or accreditations (if submitted)
• Centre ownership or control information
• Business registration details (where applicable)
• Criminal conviction record declarations or equivalents (for individual educators, where permitted by law)
• Account activity and platform usage records

subsection4.title: 3.4 Transaction and Technical Data
subsection4.content:
We may collect:

• Booking records
• Payment status
• Zing credit balances and usage
• Refund and voucher history
• Device information
• IP address
• Log files and usage analytics

section4.title: 4. Purpose of Data Collection and Use
section4.content:
We collect and use personal data for the following purposes:

• Account registration and identity verification
• Class discovery, enrolment, scheduling, and attendance tracking
• Payment processing and subscription management
• Operation of the Zing credit system
• Generation and display of class-related feedback and insights
• Platform communication and customer support
• Safeguarding, fraud prevention, and compliance checks
• Platform improvement, analytics, and service optimisation
• Compliance with legal and regulatory obligations

Personal data will not be used for purposes unrelated to the Platform without consent, unless required or permitted by law.

section5.title: 5. Feedback, Insights, and Character Profiles

section6.title: 6. Special Educational Needs (SEN) Data

section7.title: 7. Photos and Media Content
section7.content:
Photos or media uploaded by centres or coaches in relation to classes:

• may include individual photos of a child or group/class photos taken during class activities;
• may incidentally display multiple students attending the same class;
• are associated only with classes in which the child is enrolled.

By enrolling a child in a class and using the Platform, parents or legal guardians acknowledge and consent to:

• the capture and upload of class-related photos or media by centres or coaches; and
• the display of such photos or media within the Platform, including where a child may appear in group or class photos visible to other parents of enrolled students.

ClassZ does not use such photos or media for marketing, advertising, or promotional purposes unless separate consent is obtained.

Photos and media are visible only to authorised users (such as parents or guardians of enrolled students) and are used solely for class-related documentation and feedback.

Parents may request the removal of specific photos or media by contacting customer support. Requests will be reviewed and handled in accordance with applicable laws and operational requirements.

section8.title: 8. Payment Processing
section8.content:
Photos or media uploaded by centres or coaches in relation to classes:

• may include individual photos of a child or group/class photos taken during class activities;
• may incidentally display multiple students attending the same class;
• are associated only with classes in which the child is enrolled.

By enrolling a child in a class and using the Platform, parents or legal guardians acknowledge and consent to:

• the capture and upload of class-related photos or media by centres or coaches; and the display of such photos or media within the Platform, including where a child may appear in group or class photos visible to other parents of enrolled students.

All payments are processed through third-party payment service providers, such as Stripe.

ClassZ does not store full credit card numbers or sensitive payment credentials. Payment providers process personal data in accordance with their own privacy policies and applicable laws.

section9.title: 9. Data Sharing and Disclosure

section10.title: 10. Data Retention

section11.title: 11. Data Security
section11.content:
We implement reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, or alteration.

However, no system is completely secure, and users acknowledge that data transmission over the internet carries inherent risks.

section12.title: 12. User Rights

section13.title: 13. Children's Privacy
section13.content:
ClassZ relies on parents or legal guardians to provide consent for the collection and use of child data.

Parents are responsible for ensuring the accuracy and appropriateness of information submitted on behalf of their children.

section14.title: 14. Changes to This Privacy Policy
section14.content:
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.

The version in effect at the time of data collection will apply unless otherwise required by law. Continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

section15.title: 15. Contact Us
section15.content: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact ClassZ through the Platform's support channels.

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content:
Welcome to ClassZ (the "Platform"). These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the ClassZ platform, including our website, mobile application, subscription services, credits system ("Zing"), booking features, feedback tools, and related services.

By creating an account, accessing, or using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, you must not use the Platform.

section2.title: 2. Platform Role and Scope

subsection1.title: 3.1 Parent Accounts

subsection2.title: 3.2 Child Profiles

subsection3.title: 3.3 Centre Owner Accounts
subsection3.content:
Centre owners are service providers who list and operate classes on the Platform.

Centre owners may create and manage multiple centres and are responsible for submitting accurate, complete, and lawful information about their centres.

subsection4.title: 3.4 Coach Accounts
subsection4.content:
Coach accounts are sub-accounts associated with a centre and are dependent on centre approval.

Coaches are not employees or agents of ClassZ. Centre owners are solely responsible for the acts, omissions, qualifications, and conduct of their coaches.

subsection1.title: 4.1 Centre and Coach Responsibility

subsection2.title: 4.2 Vetting and Review
subsection2.content: Any review, verification, or vetting conducted by ClassZ is performed solely for platform access purposes and does not constitute certification, endorsement, or assurance of quality, safety, or suitability.

section5.title: 5. Listings, Schedules, and Minimum Student Numbers

subsection1.title: 5.1 Listings and Price Lock
subsection1.content:
Once a class or program has at least one confirmed enrolment, the listing details, schedule, and price are locked and may not be changed.

If no enrolment has been made, centres may cancel or re-list programs freely.

subsection2.title: 5.2 Minimum Student Requirement
subsection2.content:
• Some classes may require a minimum number of students to proceed, as specified by the relevant centre.
• The minimum student requirement is assessed twenty-four (24) hours before the first scheduled session.
• If the minimum number of students is not met, the centre may cancel the program up to the 24-hour cutoff.
• If the centre does not cancel the program by the 24-hour cutoff:
  → The program will automatically proceed as scheduled;
  → The program is deemed confirmed;
  → The centre may not cancel the program or any affected sessions on the basis of minimum student numbers once the program has started.
• If a program is cancelled due to minimum student numbers within the permitted timeframe:
  → Parents will receive refunds in accordance with the Refund Policy.

subsection3.title: 5.3 Schedule Rearrangements
subsection3.content:
Only schedule rearrangements submitted through and recorded on the Platform are recognised.

Centres may not unilaterally change class schedules.

Schedule changes require prior approval by ClassZ and are granted only in limited circumstances, such as emergencies or safety concerns.

If an approved rearrangement occurs and a parent cannot attend the new schedule:
• the affected session will be fully refunded;
• the centre will not receive payment for that session.

If a class is not delivered as scheduled without approval, the incident is treated as centre responsibility and may result in refunds, penalties, suspension, or termination.

subsection1.title: 6.1 Pricing Structure
subsection1.content:
Centres set a base price for their programs. ClassZ applies a platform markup and displays the final price payable by parents before checkout.

A fixed platform fee may apply per transaction and is waived for eligible subscribers.

subsection2.title: 6.2 Zing Credits and Subscriptions

subsection3.title: 6.3 Payments and Refund Method
subsection3.content:
All payments are processed via third-party payment processors.

Refunds are issued in the form of Zing credits or vouchers only and are not redeemable for cash or credit card refunds.

Platform fees are non-refundable.

subsection1.title: 7.1 Attendance Verification
subsection1.content:
Performance feedback is contingent upon recorded attendance through the Platform's attendance verification mechanism.

If attendance is not verified, no feedback will be generated.

subsection2.title: 7.2 Nature of Feedback and Insights
subsection2.content:
Feedback, ratings, charts, summaries, trends, and character profiles are generated from third-party service provider input and automated aggregation.

These features are provided for informational and reflective purposes only.

ClassZ does not assess, diagnose, evaluate, predict, or determine a child's abilities, development, personality, behaviour, or future outcomes.

The methodologies and categorizations used are not based on standardized or evidence-based assessment frameworks.

subsection3.title: 7.3 No Professional Advice
subsection3.content:
Nothing on the Platform constitutes educational, psychological, psychiatric, medical, developmental, or professional advice.

Parents remain solely responsible for interpreting and using any information displayed.

subsection4.title: 7.4 Delayed or Missing Feedback
subsection4.content:
Feedback is provided solely by centres and coaches.

Failure to provide feedback within a stated timeframe does not invalidate the class or entitle parents to a full refund.

ClassZ may, at its discretion, offer a partial coupon or voucher as a goodwill measure. Any such compensation is non-cash, non-transferable, and determined on a case-by-case basis.

section8.title: 8. Special Educational Needs (SEN)
section8.content:
Any SEN-related information is provided voluntarily by parents to assist service providers where possible.

SEN indicators and "SEN-friendly" tags are self-declared by centres and do not constitute certification, endorsement, or a guarantee of suitability or accommodation.

section9.title: 9. Refunds and Protected Booking
section9.content:
Refunds, cancellations, and compensation are governed by the Refund Policy, which forms part of these Terms.

Any "Protected Booking" benefits are subject to eligibility criteria, verification, and time limits and do not constitute an unconditional guarantee.

In the event of any inconsistency between these Terms and the Refund Policy, the Refund Policy shall prevail.

section10.title: 10. Intellectual Property
section10.content:
All Platform content, software, designs, and trademarks belong to ClassZ or its licensors.

Users grant ClassZ a non-exclusive license to use content they submit solely for Platform operation.

section11.title: 11. Limitation of Liability
section11.content:
To the maximum extent permitted by law, ClassZ shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages arising from the use of the Platform.

ClassZ is not liable for the acts or omissions of centres, coaches, or other third parties.

section12.title: 12. Indemnity

intro.content: This Refund Policy explains how refunds, credits, and vouchers work on the ClassZ platform. It applies to all parents and guardians using ClassZ to book classes and programs. This policy should be read together with the Terms & Conditions.

section1.title: 1. Key Principles
section1.content:
ClassZ is a platform that facilitates bookings between parents and service providers (centres and coaches).

Refund eligibility depends on timing, attendance, and the reason for the request.

All refunds are issued in Zing credits or vouchers only. We do not provide cash or credit-card refunds.

Platform fees are non-refundable.

subsection1.title: 2.1 Zing Credits
subsection1.content:
Zing credits are platform credits with no cash value.

Credits are non-transferable and may be used for multiple children under the same parent account.

Credits do not expire except upon account closure.

subsection2.title: 2.2 Vouchers
subsection2.content:
Vouchers may be issued for specific purposes (e.g. handling fees or goodwill compensation).

Vouchers are non-cash, non-transferable, and subject to stated terms and conditions.

section3.title: 3. Class Cancellations by Centres
section3.content:
If a centre cancels a class or session:

• Parents will receive a full refund for the affected session in accordance with the original payment method:
  Zing credits for credit-based bookings; or
  Zing credits plus any applicable voucher for card-based bookings.
• The centre will not receive payment for the cancelled session.

section4.title: 4. Minimum Student Requirement Not Met
section4.content:
Some classes require a minimum number of students to proceed.

The minimum student requirement is assessed twenty-four (24) hours before the first scheduled session.

If the minimum number of students is not met, the centre may cancel the program up to the 24-hour cutoff.

If the centre does not cancel the program by the 24-hour cutoff:
• The program will automatically proceed as scheduled;
• The program is deemed confirmed;
• The centre may not cancel the program or any affected sessions on the basis of minimum student numbers once the program has started.

If a program is cancelled due to minimum student numbers within the permitted timeframe:
• Parents will receive a full refund for all affected sessions.

section5.title: 5. Bad Weather Arrangements
section5.content: ClassZ follows official weather warnings issued by the Hong Kong Observatory or relevant authorities.

subsection1.title: 5.1 Cancelled Classes
subsection1.content:
• If a class is cancelled due to bad weather, parents are entitled to a full refund for the affected session.
• Credits are non-transferable and may be used for multiple children under the same parent account.
• Credits do not expire except upon account closure.

subsection2.title: 5.2 Rescheduled Classes
subsection2.content:
If a class is rescheduled due to approved bad-weather arrangements:
Parents who cannot attend the new session time may request a refund for that session.

subsection3.title: 5.3 Request Window
subsection3.content:
Refund requests related to bad weather must be submitted:
Any time before the class starts; and
Up to 48 hours after the rescheduled session ends.

Requests submitted after this period are not eligible for refund.

subsection1.title: 6.1 Rearrangements Recorded on the Platform
subsection1.content:
Only schedule changes submitted through and approved by the Platform are treated as official rearrangements.

If a class is rearranged with prior approval by ClassZ for reasons such as safety or emergencies:
• Parents who cannot attend the new session time may request a full refund for that session.

subsection2.title: 6.2 Classes Not Provided as Scheduled

subsection3.title: 6.3 Attendance Where No Rearrangement Is Recorded

subsection1.title: 7.1 Absence Without Valid Reason
subsection1.content:
For the purposes of this Refund Policy, a 'valid reason' is limited to circumstances expressly recognised by ClassZ under this policy, such as centre-initiated cancellation, approved rearrangement recorded on the Platform, minimum student requirement not met, or official bad-weather arrangements.

Personal circumstances of the child or parent, including illness, sick leave, scheduling conflicts, late arrival, or personal emergencies, are not considered valid reasons unless otherwise required by applicable law.

No refund, replacement session, or feedback will be provided where a child is absent under such circumstances.

subsection2.title: 7.2 Missed Sessions
subsection2.content: Missed sessions due to personal scheduling issues, late arrival, or failure to attend are not refundable unless expressly stated in this policy.

section11.title: 11. Policy Updates
section11.content: ClassZ may update this Refund Policy from time to time. The version in effect at the time of booking will apply unless otherwise required by law.
